div.div: Since the Pre-startup sequence is responsible for ensuring Safe State immediately after reset, it should run before main. In addition, since it is responsible for performing error injections that result in device resets, it is set to run before .init4 to reduce the total execution time of the pre-startup sequence (avoid having to load contents from flash into SRAM each cycle).
However, it is not safe to run in .init0, because .init2 needs to run for basic compiler assumptions to hold true and to be able to safely run C code and call functions.
